title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Acato WP REST Cache…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Acato WP REST Cache plugin due to improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This vulnerability allows code injection, potentially leading to integrity and availability impacts. The issue affects versions up to and including 2026.4.2. No patch information is currently available.
